items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Ruff and Mitchell-Ruff. I listened to some of those to get an idea.

ctx.x: Right. What was it, Willie Ruff?
Ruff and Mitchell-Ruff. I listened to some of those to get an idea. It’s almost too regal of an instrument or something. And I thought about trumpet. Anyways I gravitated to the
bass, just being naive and thinking that it was like the electric bass. Little did I know. And so that was it. And I’ve never looked back.
